dedupe_keys.name: dynamic stability of synthetic power grid models

description: Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research publishes synthetic grid topologies with simulated dynamic-stability targets. The free CC BY 4.0 Zenodo release includes ten thousand twenty-node grids, ten thousand one-hundred-node grids and one 1,910-node Texan model. HDF5 stores adjacency, source/sink indicators, basin stability, maximum frequency deviation and troublemaker labels; CSV gives network measures. Training, validation and test subsets support reproducible surrogate comparisons. These targets can benchmark screening components in power-system resilience simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this labelled collection. Homogeneous lines, synthetic generation and Monte Carlo estimation constrain physical interpretation; targets are not observed blackout rates. The linked Julia and PyTorch companion estimates roughly 550,000 CPU-hours for regenerating the two large ensembles. Its software licence was not identified. No archive was downloaded or dynamics reproduced.
